blurb.en: Read signs, notes and messages carefully, then choose the reply that fits a conversation.
blurb.vi: Đọc kĩ biển báo, ghi chú và tin nhắn, rồi chọn câu đáp phù hợp trong hội thoại.

title.vi: Từ trong thông báo và tin nhắn

must.def: You need to do it. You have no choice because it is a rule.
must.ex: Visitors *must* sign in at the front desk.

mustn't.def: It is not allowed. It is against the rules.
mustn't.ex: You *mustn't* feed the ducks in this park.

don't have to.def: You can do it if you want, but it is not necessary.
don't have to.ex: You *don't have to* bring lunch because the club gives you a sandwich.

allowed.def: If something is allowed, the rules say you can do it.
allowed.ex: Phones are *allowed* in the library, but only on silent.

until.def: Up to a certain time, and then it stops.
until.ex: The pool is open *until* 6 p.m. on Fridays.

notice.def: A short piece of writing on a wall or board that gives people information.
notice.ex: Read the *notice* on the door before you go in.

reminder.def: A message that helps you remember something you need to do.
reminder.ex: Mum sent me a *reminder* to take my sports bag.

cancelled.def: If an event is cancelled, it will not happen.
cancelled.ex: The match was *cancelled* because of the storm.

available.def: Free to use, buy or join.
available.ex: There are ten places *available* in the chess club.

permission.def: When someone says yes, you can do something.
permission.ex: You need a parent's *permission* to go on the trip.

paraphrase.def: To say the same meaning with different words.

refuse.def: To say no to something that someone asks or offers.
refuse.ex: Sam *refused* the cake because he was full.

suggest.def: To give an idea for other people to think about.
suggest.ex: I *suggest* we meet at the park at four.

reply.def: What you say or write back when someone speaks or writes to you.
reply.ex: Lan sent a quick *reply*: 'Yes, see you there!'

title.vi: Từ chỉ quy định trên biển báo

scenes.head: A sign at the climbing wall
scenes.html:
CLIMBING WALL
Children under 12 *must* climb with an adult.
You *mustn't* wear rings or watches.
You *don't have to* bring special shoes: we lend them for free.
Open *until* 7 p.m., Monday to Friday *only*.

steps.en: The words in gold tell you the rule. *must* means you need to do it.
steps.vi: Các từ màu vàng cho em biết quy định. *must* nghĩa là em bắt buộc phải làm.

steps.en: *mustn't* means it is not allowed. *don't have to* means it is not necessary.
steps.vi: *mustn't* nghĩa là không được phép. *don't have to* nghĩa là không cần thiết.

steps.en: Small words like *until* and *only* change the meaning a lot. Read them twice!
steps.vi: Những từ nhỏ như *until* và *only* làm thay đổi nghĩa rất nhiều. Hãy đọc chúng hai lần!

title.en: Who, what and when in a message
title.vi: Ai, cái gì và khi nào trong tin nhắn

scenes.head: A text message
scenes.html: Hi Freya! Science club is in *Room 12 today, not the lab*. Mr Khan is late, so we start at *3:30 instead of 3:15*. Don't forget your plant diary! Omar

steps.en: Ask three questions: Who wrote it? What has changed? When?
steps.vi: Hãy hỏi ba câu: Ai viết? Điều gì đã thay đổi? Khi nào?

steps.en: The exam options use different words. *3:30 instead of 3:15* means 'The club starts later than usual.'
steps.vi: Các lựa chọn trong bài thi dùng từ khác. *3:30 instead of 3:15* nghĩa là 'Câu lạc bộ bắt đầu muộn hơn thường lệ.'

steps.en: Wrong options use words from the text but change the meaning, like 'The club is in the lab today.'
steps.vi: Lựa chọn sai dùng từ trong bài nhưng đổi nghĩa, ví dụ 'Hôm nay câu lạc bộ học ở phòng thí nghiệm.'

title.vi: Những câu thoại khớp với nhau

scenes.head: Two friends talking
scenes.html:
Minh: Do you want to come to the bike race on Sunday?
Elena: *I'd love to, but* I'm visiting my grandma.
Minh: *Never mind.* Maybe next time.
Elena: *Thanks for asking!*

steps.en: After a question, look for an answer. Elena answers, but she says no in a polite way.
steps.vi: Sau một câu hỏi, hãy tìm câu trả lời. Elena trả lời nhưng từ chối một cách lịch sự.

steps.en: *Never mind* comes after bad news or a 'no'.
steps.vi: *Never mind* đi sau một tin không vui hoặc một lời từ chối.

steps.en: In Part 3, always check the line BEFORE and the line AFTER the gap.
steps.vi: Ở Phần 3, luôn kiểm tra câu NGAY TRƯỚC và câu NGAY SAU chỗ trống.

end.en: Great reading! You found what each sign and message really means.
end.vi: Đọc rất tốt! Em đã hiểu đúng ý nghĩa của từng biển báo và tin nhắn.

challenge.result: You spotted the rule words and chose replies that fit!

v.q: What does the sign say?
opts: Leave the glass alone so the snakes can rest.
Tap the glass gently to see the snakes.
The snakes rest only when nobody is near.
whys: The sign says 'do not tap', so even a gentle tap is wrong.
The sign doesn't say when the snakes rest. It asks you not to tap.
v.hint: Find the words 'do not'. What must you NOT do?
v.worked: 'Please *do not tap* on the glass. The snakes are *resting*.' So you leave the glass alone.

stim.head: Sign at the zoo
stim.html: Please do not tap on the glass. The snakes are resting, and loud noises frighten them.

v.q: Where can you ride a bike?
opts: on the red path
on the grass
on every path
whys: On the grass you must walk your bike.
'only' means one path, not every path.
v.hint: Look for the word 'only'.
v.worked: 'Cycling is allowed on the red path *only*.' On the grass you walk your bike.

stim.head: Sign in the park
stim.html: Cycling is allowed on the red path only. Please walk your bike on the grass.

v.q: What is Noah going to buy?
opts: white bread
brown bread
nothing
whys: The shop hasn't got any brown bread.
Noah says 'I'm getting white', so he is buying something.
v.hint: Find what the shop HASN'T got, then what Noah is getting instead.
v.worked: 'They haven't got any brown bread, *so I'm getting white*.'

stim.head: Text message
stim.html: Ines, I'm at the shop. They haven't got any brown bread, so I'm getting white. Do you want anything else? Noah

v.q: When should Ravi arrive?
opts: at half past eight
at nine o'clock
after nine
whys: 9 o'clock is when the fair starts, but Ravi must come before that.
Ravi must come before the fair starts, not after.
v.hint: Two times are in the note. Which one is for Ravi?
v.worked: 'please *come at 8:30* to set up your table.' 8:30 is half past eight.

stim.head: Note
stim.html: Ravi, the science fair starts at 9, but please come at 8:30 to set up your table. Hana

v.q: What does Ben think?
opts: The wall should open earlier.
The wall isn't much fun.
The queue is short in the morning.
whys: Ben says the wall IS fun.
Ben says the queue is always long. He doesn't say it is short in the morning.
v.hint: Look for 'I think'. What is Ben's idea?
v.worked: 'I think they *should open it earlier* in the morning.'

stim.head: Message
stim.html: The new climbing wall is fun, but the queue is always really long. I think they should open it earlier in the morning. Ben

v.q: How did Chloe feel about the walk?
opts: She enjoyed it more than she expected.
She didn't like it at all.
She only went to see the tadpoles.
whys: 'I didn't expect to like it' is about BEFORE the walk. She loved it!
Seeing the tadpoles was the best part, not the only reason she went.
v.hint: Read the whole message. How did she feel before, and how did she feel after?
v.worked: 'I *didn't expect* to like the nature walk, but I *loved* seeing the tadpoles.'

stim.head: Post on a class page
stim.html: I didn't expect to like the nature walk, but I loved seeing the tadpoles in the pond. I'm going again next month! Chloe

v.q:
Arlo: 'Would you like to try my new kite?'
Amira: '..........'
Arlo: 'Here you are. Hold it tight!'
What does Amira say?
opts: Yes, please! Can I try it now?
No, thanks. I'm going home.
I've got a new kite too.
whys: Arlo gives her the kite next, so she didn't say no.
This doesn't answer Arlo's question.
v.hint: Read Arlo's NEXT line. Does he give Amira the kite?
v.worked: Arlo says 'Here you are', so Amira said *'Yes, please!'*

v.q:
Jonas: 'I can't find my calculator anywhere.'
Sofia: '..........'
Jonas: 'Oh yes, there it is! Thanks.'
What does Sofia say?
opts: Look, isn't it under your book?
Don't worry. You can buy one later.
I like your new calculator.
whys: Jonas says 'there it is', so Sofia helped him find it.
Jonas has lost it, so Sofia can't see it to like it.
v.hint: Jonas finds it after Sofia speaks. What did she say to help?
v.worked: Jonas says '*there it is*', so Sofia showed him where it was: 'Look, isn't it under your book?'

blurb.en: Learn the rule words, read short messages and choose replies that fit.
blurb.vi: Học từ chỉ quy định, đọc tin nhắn ngắn và chọn câu đáp phù hợp.

v.q: What does the sign say?
opts: You need a cap, but goggles are your choice.
You need goggles, but a cap is your choice.
You mustn't wear a cap or goggles here.
whys: It's the goggles that are 'not necessary', not the cap.
Nothing is banned. 'must wear' means you need a cap.
v.hint: Find 'must'. What must swimmers wear?
v.worked: 'Swimmers *must wear* a swimming cap.' Goggles are '*not necessary*', so they are your choice.

stim.head: Sign at the swimming pool
stim.html: Swimmers must wear a swimming cap. Goggles are not necessary, but you can bring your own if you like.

v.q: What must students bring?
opts: an old T-shirt
some paint
their school uniform
whys: 'don't have to bring paint' means paint is not necessary.
The T-shirt goes over the uniform. The notice doesn't ask you to bring a uniform.
v.hint: Find the word 'must' in the notice.
v.worked: 'You *must bring an old T-shirt* to wear over your uniform.'

stim.head: Notice on the art room door
stim.html: Students don't have to bring paint. You must bring an old T-shirt to wear over your uniform.

v.q: What does the sign say?
opts: You can take photos if you don't use a flash.
You mustn't take any photos of the butterflies.
You can touch the butterflies if you are careful.
whys: Photos ARE allowed. Only the flash is not.
The sign asks everyone not to touch the butterflies.
v.hint: Look at the word 'but'. What is allowed and what isn't?
v.worked: 'Photos are *allowed, but no flash*.'

stim.head: Sign at the butterfly house
stim.html: Please don't touch the butterflies. Their wings are very delicate. Photos are allowed, but no flash.

v.q: Where can students put their water bottles?
opts: on the shelf by the door
next to their computer
on the computer desk
whys: No drinks are allowed near the computers.
The desk is near the computers, so bottles can't go there.
v.hint: Find the word 'must'. Where must the bottles stay?
v.worked: 'Water bottles *must stay on the shelf by the door*.'

stim.head: Sign in the computer room
stim.html: No food or drinks near the computers. Water bottles must stay on the shelf by the door.

v.q: When can you buy a smoothie?
opts: on Tuesday at 12 o'clock
on Thursday at 1 o'clock
on Wednesday at 12 o'clock
whys: 12:30 is the last time, so 1 o'clock is too late.
Smoothies are sold 'only on Tuesdays and Thursdays'.
v.hint: Check two things: the day ('only') and the time ('until').
v.worked: Smoothies are sold *only on Tuesdays and Thursdays, until 12:30*. Tuesday at 12 is inside that time.

stim.head: Notice at the school canteen
stim.html: Fresh fruit smoothies are sold only on Tuesdays and Thursdays, from 10:00 until 12:30. Price: 20,000 dong.

v.q: What does the sign say?
opts: If you arrive after 4 p.m., you can't play.
You can sign the list after the game starts.
Players must watch a game before they play.
whys: You sign the list BEFORE the game starts, not after.
Only players who come late watch. Nobody must watch first.
v.hint: Look for 'before', 'after' and 'only'.
v.worked: 'Players who come *after 4 p.m. can only watch*', so they can't play.

stim.head: Sign at the chess club
stim.html: Please sign the list before the game starts. Players who come after 4 p.m. can only watch.

title.vi: Tin nhắn ngắn: ai, cái gì, khi nào

v.q: Who is going to be late tonight?
opts: Isla
Kenji
Biscuit
whys: Kenji is asked to feed the pet. He isn't late.
Biscuit is the pet that needs food.
v.hint: Who wrote the message? Find 'I'm staying late'.
v.worked: Isla wrote the message and says '*I'm staying late* at football practice.'

stim.head: Text message
stim.html: Kenji, can you feed Biscuit tonight? I'm staying late at football practice. His food is in the blue tin. Thanks! Isla

v.q: Who should phone Grandma?
opts: Mum
Dad
Lan
whys: Dad called, but he isn't asked to phone Grandma.
Lan wrote the note. She isn't asked to phone.
v.hint: The note is for Mum. Who is 'you'?
v.worked: The note starts 'Mum', so 'Grandma wants *you* to phone her back' means Mum.

stim.head: Note on the fridge
stim.html: Mum, Dad called. He's going to pick up Bao from swimming, so you don't need to go. Grandma wants you to phone her back. Lan

v.q: What do club members need to bring?
opts: gloves and water
spades and gloves
a tree and water
whys: The club has enough spades now.
Members plant trees, but they don't bring them.
v.hint: Find 'please bring'.
v.worked: 'We have enough spades now, so *please bring gloves and a bottle of water*.'

stim.head: App message from the Eco Club
stim.html: Our tree-planting day is still on! We have enough spades now, so please bring gloves and a bottle of water.

v.q: What does Priya want Sami to do?
opts: check the spelling on the poster
finish the poster for her
print the poster on Monday
whys: Priya has already finished the poster.
Priya says 'I'll print it', so she will do that herself.
v.hint: Find the question 'Can you...?'
v.worked: '*Can you check the spelling* before Friday?'

stim.head: Email extract
stim.html: Hi Sami, I've finished the poster for our invention project. Can you check the spelling before Friday? I'll print it on Monday. Priya

v.q: When do the matches begin?
opts: 17 November
10 November
24 November
whys: 10 November is the last day to sign up.
24 November is the day for prizes.
v.hint: Three dates! Find the word 'start'.
v.worked: '*Matches start on 17 November* at 8 a.m.'

stim.head: Poster
stim.html: Junior Badminton Cup. Sign up by 10 November. Matches start on 17 November at 8 a.m. Prizes on 24 November.

v.q: When is the film club meeting now?
opts: on Thursday
on Wednesday
on Tuesday
whys: Wednesday was the old day. It isn't on Wednesday any more.
'the day after' Wednesday is later, not earlier.
v.hint: What day comes after Wednesday?
v.worked: 'It's *the day after*' Wednesday, so it's on Thursday.

stim.head: Text message
stim.html: Mai, the film club meeting has moved. It isn't on Wednesday any more. It's the day after, at the same time. Huy

v.q: Tariq asks: 'How did you get to the museum?' What is the best reply?
opts: We went by train.
We went on Saturday.
Yes, it was amazing.
whys: 'How' asks about the way you travelled, not the day.
'How...?' is not a yes/no question.
v.hint: Look at the question word. What does 'How' ask about here?
v.worked: '*How* did you get there?' asks about transport, so '*by train*' answers it.

v.q: Yuki asks: 'Have you ever seen a dolphin?' What is the best reply?
opts: Yes, once, on holiday in Nha Trang.
It's my favourite sea animal.
Dolphins live in the sea.
whys: This doesn't say yes or no about your own experience.
This is a fact about dolphins, not an answer about you.
v.hint: 'Have you ever...?' asks about your life. Look for yes or no.
v.worked: '*Have you ever* seen...?' needs yes or no: '*Yes, once*, on holiday.'

v.q:
Nam: 'Can you come to my party on Saturday?'
Ethan: '..........'
Nam: 'Oh, what a shame! Maybe next time.'
What does Ethan say?
opts: Sorry, I've got a swimming race.
Yes, of course! I'd love to come!
Great! What time does it start?
whys: Nam says 'what a shame', so Ethan can't come.
Nam's next line doesn't give a time.
v.hint: Read Nam's NEXT line. Is it good news or bad news?
v.worked: '*What a shame!*' follows a 'no', so Ethan says '*Sorry*, I've got a swimming race.'

v.q:
Duc: 'I've lost my bus pass.'
Mia: '..........'
Duc: 'Thanks! That would be great.'
What does Mia say?
opts: Don't worry. I can lend you money.
Great! I've got a new one too.
Thanks, that's really kind of you.
whys: 'Great!' is wrong after bad news.
Duc says 'Thanks' next, so Mia must offer help, not say thanks.
v.hint: Duc thanks Mia next. So what did Mia offer?
v.worked: Duc says '*Thanks! That would be great*', so Mia offered help: 'I can *lend you* money.'

v.q: Linh: 'Thanks for helping me with my science project.' What is the best reply?
opts: You're welcome. It was fun!
Yes, please. I'd love some help.
No, thanks. I can do it.
whys: 'Yes, please' answers an offer, not a thank-you.
'No, thanks' says no to an offer.
v.hint: What do we say after someone says 'thank you'?
v.worked: After '*Thanks*', we say '*You're welcome*.'

v.q:
Khoa: 'Why don't we take the dog for a walk?'
Thao: '..........'
Khoa: 'OK, I'll get the lead.'
What does Thao say?
opts: Good idea! Let's go now.
Because he is hungry.
No, he doesn't like the park.
whys: 'Why don't we...?' is an idea, not a real 'why' question.
Khoa gets the lead next, so Thao must agree.
v.hint: 'Why don't we...?' is a suggestion. Then read Khoa's next line.
v.worked: '*Why don't we*...?' is a suggestion, and Khoa gets the lead, so Thao agrees: '*Good idea!*'

blurb.en: Practise Reading Part 2 (short texts) and Part 3 (complete the conversation).
blurb.vi: Luyện Phần 2 của bài Đọc (văn bản ngắn) và Phần 3 (hoàn thành đoạn hội thoại).

title.vi: Phần 2: biển báo và thông báo

v.q: What does it say?
opts: Players need shoes with light-coloured soles.
Only new players can come on Thursdays.
Players should wear trainers with black soles.
whys: New players are 'welcome', but the other players come too.
Black soles mark the floor, so they are not wanted.
v.hint: Read the reason after the colon (:). Which colour is a problem?
v.worked: 'Please wear trainers with *white soles*: black soles mark the floor.' White is a light colour.

stim.head: Notice at the sports hall
stim.html: Basketball training: Thursdays, 4 to 5 p.m. New players are welcome. Please wear trainers with white soles: black soles mark the floor.

v.q: What does it say?
opts: Wash your hands after you feed the goats.
Children must feed the goats before 11 a.m.
Wash your hands before you go near the goats.
whys: Children 'can' help, and feeding time is at 11, not before.
The sign says 'afterwards', not before.
v.hint: Look for a time word: before, at, afterwards.
v.worked: 'please *wash your hands* at the tap *afterwards*', which means after feeding the goats.

stim.head: Sign at a farm
stim.html: Feeding time for the goats is 11 a.m. Children can help, but please wash your hands at the tap afterwards.

v.q: What happens to lost things after two weeks?
opts: They are given to a charity shop.
They are kept in the office.
They go in a box outside the shop.
whys: They stay in a box OUTSIDE the office, and only for two weeks.
The box is outside the office, not outside the shop.
v.hint: Find the words 'After that'.
v.worked: '*After that, it goes to the charity shop*.' 'Given to' means the same as 'goes to'.

stim.head: Sign in the school corridor
stim.html: Lost property is kept in the box outside the office for two weeks. After that, it goes to the charity shop.

v.q: What does it say?
opts: You need to arrive before the doors close.
Shows start five minutes after the doors open.
Late visitors can go in after five minutes.
whys: The doors CLOSE five minutes before a show. The sign says nothing about opening.
Late visitors 'cannot go in'.
v.hint: What happens to late visitors? So what must you do?
v.worked: The doors close before each show and '*late visitors cannot go in*', so you must arrive in time.

stim.head: Notice at the planetarium
stim.html: Shows start every hour. The doors close five minutes before each show, and late visitors cannot go in.

v.q: What does it say?
opts: Children under 8 can't ride on the other tracks.
Riders under 8 don't have to wear a helmet.
Helmets are only needed on the small track.
whys: Helmets are for everyone, 'at all times'.
'at all times' means on every track.
v.hint: Who 'may only use' the small track?
v.worked: 'Riders under 8 *may only use the small track*', so they can't use any other track.

stim.head: Sign at the bike park
stim.html: Helmets must be worn at all times. Riders under 8 may only use the small track.

v.q: What does it say?
opts: You can swap a book for another book.
You can bring a comic instead of a book.
You must take home a magazine.
whys: Comics are 'not accepted'.
Magazines are not part of the swap.
v.hint: Find 'bring' and 'take'.
v.worked: 'Bring one book you have finished and *take a new one* home.' That is a swap.

stim.head: Poster in the library
stim.html: Book swap! Bring one book you have finished and take a new one home. Comics and magazines are not accepted.

title.vi: Phần 2: tin nhắn và ý kiến

v.q: What is Maya worried about?
opts: She may not be able to use her tablet.
She has broken the charger for her tablet.
Leo has lost the tablet that she needs.
whys: She can't FIND the charger. It isn't broken.
Maya's charger is missing. Leo hasn't lost anything.
v.hint: Why does Maya need the charger tonight?
v.worked: The battery is '*almost dead*' and she '*needs it for her coding lesson tonight*', so she may not be able to use it.

stim.head: Text message
stim.html: Hi Leo, I can't find my tablet charger anywhere! The battery is almost dead and I need the tablet for my coding lesson tonight. Have you got a charger I can borrow? Maya

v.q: What is Phong worried about?
opts: Pepper may be unwell.
Pepper has run away.
Pepper eats too much.
whys: Phong has taken Pepper for a walk. She is with him.
Pepper 'didn't eat' her breakfast, so this is the opposite.
v.hint: Find the question at the end. Why does Phong ask it?
v.worked: Pepper '*didn't eat* her breakfast again' and is '*very quiet*', so Phong asks about the vet.

stim.head: Note
stim.html: Dad, I've taken Pepper for her walk. She didn't eat her breakfast again, and she's very quiet today. Do you think we should take her to the vet? Phong

v.q: What is Lucia's opinion of the museum?
opts: The best part was the flight simulator.
Everything in the gift shop was brilliant.
She doesn't want to go back.
whys: The gift shop was 'expensive', not brilliant.
She says 'I'd go back', so she does want to.
v.hint: Find the words that show feelings: 'brilliant', 'expensive'.
v.worked: 'the *flight simulator was brilliant*. I'd go back *just to try it again*!'

stim.head: Message from a friend
stim.html: I went to the new science museum yesterday. The gift shop was expensive, but the flight simulator was brilliant. I'd go back just to try it again! Lucia

v.q: What did most of the class think?
opts: They liked the fish soup.
The green salad was their favourite.
They didn't want to vote.
whys: The green salad 'wasn't popular'.
The text says they 'can' vote. It doesn't say they don't want to.
v.hint: Find the words 'Most of us'.
v.worked: '*Most of us loved the fish soup*.' 'Liked' is a paraphrase of 'loved'.

stim.head: Post on the class website
stim.html: Our class tried the new healthy menu this week. Most of us loved the fish soup, but the green salad wasn't popular. Mr Lewis says we can vote next week. Class 5A

v.q: What must skaters do if they feel tired?
opts: Go out through the red gate.
Make a fist with their hands.
Wait by the red gate on the ice.
whys: Making a fist is for when you fall over.
'leave the ice' means go off it, not wait on it.
v.hint: Find 'If you feel tired'.
v.worked: 'If you feel tired, *leave the ice by the red gate*.'

stim.head: Notice at the ice rink
stim.html: If you fall over, make a fist with your hands so other skaters don't skate over your fingers. If you feel tired, leave the ice by the red gate.

v.q: What does the message say?
opts: Students should keep working on their designs.
The printer will be fixed this week.
Students can print their models this week.
whys: 'we can't print our models this week', so the printer won't be ready this week.
'we can't print our models this week.'
v.hint: What does the club want students to do now?

items.en: *must* = it is necessary. *mustn't* = it is not allowed. *don't have to* / *needn't* = it is not necessary.
items.vi: *must* = bắt buộc. *mustn't* = không được phép. *don't have to* / *needn't* = không cần thiết.
example: You *don't have to* bring a helmet: we lend you one.

items.vi: Từ chỉ thời gian làm thay đổi nghĩa: *before*, *after*, *until*, *only*, *every*.

items.en: The right option says the same idea in different words. This is a *paraphrase*.
items.vi: Lựa chọn đúng nói cùng một ý bằng từ khác. Đó là *diễn đạt lại*.
example: Right option: '*You can't use* your phone in lessons.'

items.en: Wrong options use words from the text but change the meaning: *all* / *some*, *already* / *not yet*, *can* / *must*.
items.vi: Lựa chọn sai dùng từ trong bài nhưng đổi nghĩa: *all* / *some*, *already* / *not yet*, *can* / *must*.
example: Wrong option: '*All* the tickets are sold.'

items.en: In a conversation, check the line *before* AND the line *after* the gap. A question needs an answer; 'Never mind' follows a 'no'.
items.vi: Trong hội thoại, kiểm tra câu *trước* VÀ câu *sau* chỗ trống. Câu hỏi cần câu trả lời; 'Never mind' đi sau lời từ chối.
example: A: *Where* did you go? B: *To the beach*.
A: Can you come? B: *Sorry, I can't*. A: *Never mind!*

items.en: Small words must match: *it* for one thing, *they* for many, *yes, I have* after *Have you...?*
items.vi: Các từ nhỏ phải khớp: *it* cho một vật, *they* cho nhiều vật, *yes, I have* sau *Have you...?*
example: A: Do you like your new trainers? B: Yes, *they're* really comfortable.
A: *Have* you finished? B: Yes, I *have*.

check.sentence: You {don't have to|mustn't|must} bring a towel: the pool gives you one.
The shop is open {until|before|since} 8 p.m., and then it closes.
'Closed on Mondays' means you {can't|can|must} visit on Mondays.
'I haven't finished yet' means the work is {not done|done|easy}.
After 'Thank you so much!' you say {You're welcome.|Yes, please.|Never mind.}
A: Did you like the new games? B: Yes, {they|it|he} were great fun.
